import api
import queueing
import worker
from queueing import payload
import pytest

# Test api.submit with region parameter
def test_submit_with_region():
    # Test default region (worldwide)
    enqueue_mock = lambda p: p
    result = api.submit("owner1", enqueue_mock)
    assert result["region"] == "worldwide"
    
    # Test explicit region (europe)
    result = api.submit("owner2", enqueue_mock, region="europe")
    assert result["region"] == "europe"
    
    # Test explicit region (americas)
    result = api.submit("owner3", enqueue_mock, region="americas")
    assert result["region"] == "americas"

# Test queueing.payload with region parameter
def test_payload_with_region():
    # Test default region (worldwide)
    task = queueing.payload("owner1")
    assert task["owner"] == "owner1"
    assert task["region"] == "worldwide"
    
    # Test explicit region (europe)
    task = queueing.payload("owner2", region="europe")
    assert task["owner"] == "owner2"
    assert task["region"] == "europe"
    
    # Test explicit region (americas)
    task = queueing.payload("owner3", region="americas")
    assert task["owner"] == "owner3"
    assert task["region"] == "americas"

# Test worker.execute with region validation
def test_worker_execute_region_validation():
    # Test valid region (worldwide)
    def collect_mock(owner, region):
        return (owner, region)
    
    task = {"owner": "owner1", "region": "worldwide"}
    result = worker.execute(task, collect_mock)
    assert result == ("owner1", "worldwide")
    
    # Test valid region (europe)
    task = {"owner": "owner2", "region": "europe"}
    result = worker.execute(task, collect_mock)
    assert result == ("owner2", "europe")
    
    # Test valid region (americas)
    task = {"owner": "owner3", "region": "americas"}
    result = worker.execute(task, collect_mock)
    assert result == ("owner3", "americas")
    
    # Test invalid region (should raise ValueError)
    task = {"owner": "owner4", "region": "invalid_region"}
    try:
        worker.execute(task, collect_mock)
        assert False, "Expected ValueError for invalid region"
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "Invalid region: invalid_region. Allowed values are: worldwide, europe, americas."

# Test backward compatibility (no region specified)
def test_backward_compatibility():
    # Test api.submit without region parameter (legacy)

    result = api.submit("owner_legacy", enqueue_mock)
    assert result["region"] == "worldwide"
    
    # Test queueing.payload without region parameter (legacy)
    task = queueing.payload("owner_legacy")
    assert task["region"] == "worldwide"
    
    # Test worker.execute with no region key (legacy)
    def collect_mock(owner, region):
        return (owner, region)
    
    task = {"owner": "owner_legacy"}  # No region key
    result = worker.execute(task, collect_mock)
    assert result == ("owner_legacy", "worldwide")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_submit_with_region()
    test_payload_with_region()
    test_worker_execute_region_validation()
    test_backward_compatibility()
    print("All tests passed!")
